covers: A standards implementation avoids incomplete sorted-JSON identity rules.
reconsider_when: Published RFC vectors fail or compatibility changes.

covers: Published data is useful provenance; generic score and presence never prove suitability.
reconsider_when: License, published data shape, or attribution terms change.

covers: Vale owns repeatable offline checks across hand-authored public Markdown; First Reader, local ZeroSlop checks, and human fact-and-tone review retain the judgment roles it cannot supply.
reconsider_when: The pinned version cannot lint the selected sources deterministically, or the project-owned rules create repeated false positives.

covers: Existing systems remain authoritative for transport, inventory, discovery, security, and rendering; the small cross-context receipt layer remains unique.
reconsider_when: An established component supplies the complete residual under the same privacy and mutation guarantees.
License documentation and fail-closed last-known-good behavior are resolved upstream.
watch: GPL and content boundaries plus observed last-known-good failures make embedding unjustified.

covers: The interface is useful prior art; credential, provider, plugin, and release-provenance concerns keep it out of the runtime.
reconsider_when: Credential storage, outbound boundaries, and verifiable release provenance are independently resolved.
A local static boundary with no direct mutation or analytics becomes the default.
watch: Supabase, provider, telemetry, and direct mutation surfaces are disproportionate to this release.

covers: Click owns parsing and help while typed domain validation stays in ShouldaUsedThat.
reconsider_when: The selected major version becomes incompatible or an already-used component fully owns parsing.

covers: pytest is the single test runner; property and coverage tools have distinct roles.
reconsider_when: Supported Python compatibility or plugin behavior becomes unsuitable.

covers: The pinned First Reader skill supplies a context-free method for reviewing first-contact and journey-level public surfaces.
reconsider_when: Reader reviews repeatedly fail to find the primary path, or the editorial workflow can no longer run without sending unpublished prose to a hosted service.
unknowns: Simulated reader responses are hypotheses rather than measured user behavior.
watch: The parent repository is a broad learning map, not a production dependency or blanket endorsement; each example still needs independent dependency, security, and fit review.

covers: CodeQL supplies hosted source analysis while other tools retain separate dependency and workflow roles.
reconsider_when: GitHub changes the supported action or the selected SHA is no longer valid.

covers: uv owns the environment and lock without layering Poetry, tox, or Nox.
reconsider_when: The lock or cross-platform execution contract stops being reproducible.

covers: JMESPath avoids a custom DSL or arbitrary Python evaluation.
reconsider_when: A required real-world filter cannot be expressed safely.

covers: Two complete MIT-licensed skills are pinned as guidance and are not runtime dependencies.
reconsider_when: A later pinned revision is fully reviewed and materially improves the workflow.
A stable release and documented deterministic export contract exist.
watch: The static approach is relevant, but stable releases and an auditable export contract are not yet established.

reconsider_when: Strict build, search, accessibility, or no-third-party-request validation fails.
watch: The exact pre-1.0 version is removable and must prove deterministic, accessible, no-runtime-network output.

covers: Pydantic validates external records while workflow rules remain explicit services.
reconsider_when: A major version breaks the strict immutable record boundary.
